name: eva-agent
description: Eva's own coding agent: a self-developed agent loop that runs on EVA models.

chatSessions.name: eva-agent
chatSessions.welcomeMessage: Eva's own coding agent. Describe a task and it will plan, edit and verify.
chatSessions.inputPlaceholder: Describe a task for Eva Agent

eva-agent.maxTurns.description: Safety cap on how many model round-trips one request may take. The loop stops and reports when it is reached.

eva-agent.modelVendor.description: Vendor whose models the agent loop runs on. The default is the EVA gateway published by the Eva AI extension.
